controls: K: identical P with adaptive neighbor bookkeeping
comparison: All tensors contribute; no posthoc tensor or mode selection. Use original row widths and offset INT4 coordinates. Separate encoder, decoder and repeat processes. Authenticate original-model reserialization and compare P to retained prior per-tensor archives.
mutation: Fifteen unit pseudocounts per context; identical existing fixed_tree Q11 rounding; update after decoded symbol; halve upward at total 65536. A and D allocate sixteen rows; A uses only row zero. D uses predecessor or row-start context. No transmitted count tables for A/D.
accounting: Count framing, flush, and any stored tables in each substream. Inventory required source and executable separately. This omits original tensor metadata, non-INT4 container payloads and complete runtime/license/option multiplicities; no full model, native probability or corpus score claim.
